results.label: include_operand_comment
results.reason: the firmware's include set is pinned, and <generated/c/*x*/sr.h> is not in it: every rule in this gate reads ONE file, so an include it does not know about is text in the translation unit that no rule reads. A #include of a .c keeps the object count at one, so the single-translation-unit check is satisfied honestly while the closure reads the wrong file
